description: CNDC’s operational service describes generation, demand, system frequency, scheduled dispatch, outages, hydrology and realised dispatch. It also labels marginal-cost and area-balance information and export controls. The provider is Comité Nacional de Despacho de Carga. Coverage: Coverage is Bolivia’s interconnected system. The realised-dispatch description refers to SCADA readings on the hour; other panels have different update and forecast periods. Access: The public page’s field labels and methodological notes were read. Dynamic values remained loading, and exports were not requested. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The static normal-status label is not evidence of live grid condition. Forecasts, planned outages and realised SCADA measurements must remain distinct. For simulation it identifies official operating, outage and hydro-input series. Related resources: This service complements the CNDC statistical-document archive reviewed separately.
